summary: LexinFintech Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing its first quarter 2026 unaudited financial results via a press release. The filing reports quarterly operational and financial metrics, including loan originations, revenue, and net income. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private proposal, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change is announced. The filing is a routine earnings report, not a special-situation event.
